name: Availability
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the importance of being available and responsive to God's call, as seen in Isaiah 6:8 where the prophet willingly offers himself to serve. Availability to God involves wholehearted love and service, demonstrated by obedience to His commandments (Deuteronomy 28:1) and serving with joy and gladness (Deuteronomy 28:47). Jesus' invitation to follow Him and become fishers of men (Mark 1:17) further highlights the need for readiness to engage in God's mission, grounded in loving God fully and loving others as oneself (Luke 10:27).
